case.summary: Automated monitoring flagged transaction 3441648 ($49.91) on card C09530-K1 after the second-generation model assigned a score of 0.992 despite a low legacy risk score of 0.14. Cardholder C09530-K1 transacts almost exclusively in person for product category W, making this online purchase of product H an abrupt departure from baseline behavior. Graph investigation revealed that transacting device D003615 is the hub of an active card-not-present fraud operation, linking eight cards within seven days with an extreme fraud lift of 21.19. Moreover, device D003615 is tied to twelve prior confirmed fraud cases and exhibited rapid-fire ~$50 purchases across multiple distinct cards. The transaction is confirmed fraudulent under the card_not_present_fraud pattern, warranting immediate card blocking and regulatory reporting.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details a coordinated card-not-present fraud scheme involving customer C09530, card C09530-K1, and device D003615. On November 8, 2016, at 18:56:15 UTC, transaction 3441648 for $49.91 was conducted online in product category H associated with billing region 264. The cardholder's baseline history consists almost entirely of in-person purchases in product category W (149 of 155 historical transactions), rendering this online transaction an abrupt departure from established activity. The purchase was executed via device D003615, identified with the profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.2.5 | mobile safari generic | 2436x1125'. Knowledge graph analysis identified device D003615 as an active fraud vector, connecting eight cards within a seven-day window with an elevated fraud lift of 21.19. Device D003615 directly links subject card C09530-K1 to five other compromised cards, specifically C02716-K2, C03237-K1, C04661-K1, C06147-K2, and C06374-K1, each exhibiting near-identical ~$50 online purchases for product H. Indicating automated or scripted abuse, device D003615 processed transactions on cards C06147-K2 ($49.98) and C04661-K1 ($50.07) just seven seconds apart on November 6, 2016. Furthermore, device D003615 is linked to twelve confirmed fraud closed cases, including CC-5231, CC-3893, and CC-3725, with only one cleared case. Total confirmed fraudulent exposure on card C09530-K1 is $49.91. The bank has blocked card C09530-K1 to prevent further losses and initiated ongoing monitoring on all connected cards.

stop_reason: The investigation ended pursuant to policy section 6 because the assessed fraud probability reached 0.97, well above the 0.85 decisive threshold, supported by multiple independent incriminating evidence bases (holder behavioral departure, cross-card device sharing with high lift, and twelve linked confirmed-fraud cases) such that further inquiry would not change the outcome.
